name: Universal TV Network Status
description: Shows connection status indicator so you know if your TV is still online

params.code: var dot = document.createElement('div'); dot.id = 'tv-net-status'; dot.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:12px;right:70px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#34d399;z-index:99997;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(52,211,153,0.5);transition:background 0.3s;'; document.body.appendChild(dot); window.addEventListener('offline', function() { dot.style.background = '#f87171'; dot.style.boxShadow = '0 0 6px rgba(248,113,113,0.5)'; }); window.addEventListener('online', function() { dot.style.background = '#34d399'; dot.style.boxShadow = '0 0 6px rgba(52,211,153,0.5)'; }); if (!navigator.onLine) { dot.style.background = '#f87171'; dot.style.boxShadow = '0 0 6px rgba(248,113,113,0.5)'; } return 'network-status-active';
